name: Four Seasons Bangkok at Chao Phraya River
positioning: Riverside hotel on the Chao Phraya River in Bangkok's Charoen Krung area, with two infinity pools and an Urban Wellness Centre
best_for: Travelers who want a riverside base with river-view rooms
Guests who want a spa and wellness centre on site

facts.text: The hotel has 299 guest rooms and suites.
The hotel is on the Chao Phraya River in the Charoen Krung Road area.
The hotel has two outdoor riverfront infinity pools.
Interior designer Jean-Michel Gathy designed the hotel's interiors.
A complimentary shuttle boat runs between the hotel, BTS Saphan Taksin and ICONSIAM Shopping Centre.
The nearest BTS Skytrain station is Saphan Taksin, a 15-minute walk from the hotel.
The hotel is a 40-minute drive from Suvarnabhumi International Airport.
Yu Ting Yuan serves authentic Cantonese cuisine.
BKK Social Club is a cocktail bar at the hotel.

highlights.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and high ceilings.
The Premier River-View Room looks out over the Chao Phraya River.
Riva del Fiume serves Italian dishes on the Chao Phraya River.
Chao Phraya Terrace is a farm-to-table Thai charcoal grill restaurant.
The Urban Wellness Centre includes a spa and a fitness centre with a lap pool.

considerations.text: Riva del Fiume is closed for the season, reopening October 27, 2026.
The nearest BTS Skytrain station, Saphan Taksin, is a 15-minute walk from the hotel.
Chao Phraya Terrace is a seasonal restaurant.
WhataHotel notes that the distance from central shopping districts requires transportation.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
